task: example: shape of an acceptance ledger the foreman publishes
rules: one item = one gradable fact = one targeted command that decides that item alone
'the whole suite passes' is exactly one item; never repeat the full suite per item
a check should finish in seconds; give a per-item timeout only for builds
a boundary item asserts that one capability of the next tier is absent; its test passes when the capability is missing (never use a test that is expected to fail: a crash would pass too)
items a command cannot decide carry check: null and are judged by the auditor

items.desc: health route answers 200 with the documented body
create returns the documented status and fields
invalid input returns the documented error, never an unhandled one
boundary: the next tier's new capability is absent from this folder
every fixed name in the task appears verbatim in the source (judgement: names are graded literally)
